text: 3 See Humbel's Political Essory in the Kingdom of New Spain. He mentions that at Yera Cruz: the emigrated thermometer som- times falls, owing to those northern blasts, to 0 or to 52 degrees of Palaresheit; and that even at Mexico they sometimes, though rarely, bring down the thermometers to the freezing point.
